# Premium minimal

Quiet confidence. Warm paper, editorial type, and generous space.

## Use

Use for leadership communication, learning pages, polished documentation, and focused dashboards.

## Essential traits

- One prominent primary action per content block
- Editorial heading contrast
- Warm neutral canvas

## Typography

Georgia, serif for headings; system sans-serif for body text.

## Layout and surfaces

Generous whitespace, narrow reading measure, subtle rules, clear hierarchy. Opaque paper surfaces, 12px corner radius, restrained shadow.

## Palette

- background: #fbfaf7
- surface: #ffffff
- text: #222b28
- muted: #59645e
- accent: #a3422d
- border: #dcded8

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Premium minimal to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia, serif for headings; system sans-serif for body text. Generous whitespace, narrow reading measure, subtle rules, clear hierarchy. Opaque paper surfaces, 12px corner radius, restrained shadow. Palette: background #fbfaf7, surface #ffffff, text #222b28, muted #59645e, accent #a3422d, border #dcded8. Essential traits: One prominent primary action per content block; Editorial heading contrast; Warm neutral canvas. Avoid: Decorative gradients; Heavy glow; Low-contrast gray text. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
